QuestInfo.name: [Rose Garden] The Queen's Bouquet
QuestInfo.0: Cecilia seems to be making something. Ask her about it.
QuestInfo.1: Cecilia asked you to take the rose bouquet to Ifia.\r\n#b(If you lose it, you can talk to Cecilia to get another, but she might be sad.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the rose bouquet to Ifia.

0.0: Ta-da! A bouquet! I think Ifia would love to have this, no? Maybe it will take her mind off the whole...y'know.

yes.0: I poured my heart and soul...okay, maybe just soul. But I poured a ton of it into each individual rose. I wanted this to be perfect!\r\n#b(Bring the bouquet to Ifia.)#k

no.0: This isn't just any bouquet! It's MY bouquet! Hand-made!

1.0: Cecilia was such a wonderful woman. I still remember teaching her to care for the flowers. The castle staff said it was beneath me, but I could not resist tending the garden when I had the chance.\r\n

yes.0: Is this not the most beautiful bouquet?

npc.0: I poured my heart and soul...okay, maybe just soul. But I poured a ton of it into each individual rose. I wanted this to be perfect!\r\n(Bring the bouquet to Ifia.)

item.0: Yes, what brings you here?\r\n\r\n(You need a Rose Bouquet. Go to Cecilia if you lost it.)

lost.0: You...lost the bouquet? The one I poured my soul and...soul into?

yes.0: What kind of a jerk would lose something a GHOST made by HAND?
